name: Merchloom
tagline: Branded swag your customers actually keep — designed, stored, and shipped for you.
positioning: Merchloom is the swag platform for small teams: design once, hold inventory in our warehouse, and send a box in three clicks.

hero.h1: Swag that feels considered, not clearance-bin.
hero.sub: Merchloom helps owner-operators design, warehouse, and ship branded goods your customers keep on their desk — without the minimum-order guessing games.

features.title: Design once, reorder forever
features.description: Upload your logo and we build a locked brand kit — colors, placement, and stitch files — so every tee and tote matches the last, even a year later.

features.title: We hold the inventory
features.description: Stop stacking hoodie boxes in the storage closet. We warehouse your pieces and show live stock counts, so you only reorder what's actually running low.

features.title: Send a box in three clicks
features.description: Pick a recipient, choose a kit, hit send. We pack, add the handwritten-style card, and ship — with tracking that lands in your inbox.

features.title: No mystery minimums
features.description: Order 12 mugs or 1,200. We show real per-unit pricing up front, including setup, so you can quote a client event without a sales call.

features.title: Recipient address collection
features.description: Send a link, let people enter their own shipping details, and we handle the rest — no spreadsheet of half-typed apartment numbers.

features.title: Reorder alerts before you run dry
features.description: When a popular item dips below your threshold, we nudge you with a one-tap reorder so onboarding kits never go out empty.

testimonials.quote: We used to keep four bins of old shirts in the back office and still ran out mid-launch. Merchloom holds everything and reorders itself. Our welcome kits finally look like we planned them.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: I run a 9-person agency. Sending client gifts used to eat an afternoon per event. Now it's a link and three clicks, and the boxes actually look premium.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ferro

testimonials.quote: The brand kit lock is the quiet hero. Every batch matches, so I stopped playing color detective with each new supplier. It just shows up right.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramesh

homepage.footerBlurb: Merchloom is branded swag for small teams — designed once, warehoused for you, and shipped with the kind of care your customers notice.
